dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: The skill aggregates many documented limits (3000‑page async cap, KMS policy needs, SNS role trust) and presents a useful dependency graph, but almost all of this information is already available in AWS documentation; the added value is a modest synthesis rather than brand‑new expert insight.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Provides an AWS‑specific decision flow: sync vs async based on page count, feature‑type selection, required S3/Input/OutputConfig, SNS role, KMS policy, Lambda limits, and document‑splitting logic. The only shortfall is a missing explicit step for quota‑increase request when ProvisionedThroughputExceeded occurs.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Contains a concrete NEVER list with reasons (e.g., never use DetectDocumentText for forms, never call sync API on multipage PDFs, never cross‑region S3). Lacks a few common pitfalls such as cost‑explosion from large async jobs and pagination‑related memory pressure.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter is complete (name, description, version, author, license, compatibility, keywords, tags, dependencies, metadata). The description clearly states WHAT the skill does, WHEN to invoke, and provides activation keywords. No missing fields.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: The document layers high‑level mindset, quick‑navigation table, then deep sections (heuristics, step‑by‑step, error handling). However the initial sections are dense, forcing the reader to parse many details before reaching the concise checklist.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Calibrates tightly for fragile async jobs (page limits, region constraints, KMS policy) and leaves generous freedom for creative feature combos. Missing explicit safeguards for destructive actions (e.g., accidental re‑deployment or resource deletion) and no explicit “dry‑run” mode for high‑risk changes.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable pattern (Mindset → Heuristics → Stepwise Process → NEVER list → Output format). The structure is consistent with other CloudOps skills, though the ordering of sections is a bit ad‑hoc (e.g., error handling appears after the checklist).

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides ready‑to‑copy CLI commands, a checklist that an agent can emit verbatim, and error‑handling guidance. Missing edge‑case handling for pagination of GetDocumentAnalysis results and for quota‑limit throttling, which could cause execution failures.
